name: html-periodic-table
description: A static, accessible teaching reference for HTML elements

scripts.format: prettier --write index.html css/style.css js/main.js scripts/*.mjs tests/*.js playwright.config.js *.md package.json .htmlvalidate.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check index.html css/style.css js/main.js scripts/*.mjs tests/*.js playwright.config.js *.md package.json .htmlvalidate.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
